file_dispositions.reason: Removes the obsolete zero-dropout-only restriction and links the existing adapter guide. This is current entrypoint guidance, with no trial-specific results or default changes.
Documents training randomness, inference mode, supported decoder targets, and existing output-head/DPO exclusions. The example keeps dropout=0; no scientific or accelerator acceptance claim is added.

Adds the adapter dropout module at the factor-input boundary and routes the wrapper second subkey, leaving the base input undropped. Existing initialization, factor sharding, trainability, merging, and export mechanisms remain the maintained path.

Small pure-array Equinox dropout and immutable DropoutLayout express logical mask permutation, feature unflattening and replication. The layout is a shape/permutation value at the projection boundary; it contains no model-name registry, Haliax dependency, experiment selection, or historical reproduction machinery.

Extends the existing projection protocol and concrete base Linear with optional key/layout keywords. The concrete base intentionally ignores them, permitting uniform projection calls. Existing implementations/call sites are consistent; there is no old/new signature probing or compatibility shim.

Uses existing BlockFoldable.get_layer in paged decode. The previous unconditional named slicing indexes shared Python dropout.inference booleans. Stacked.get_layer preserves non-layer leaves, and BlockSeq.get_layer selects its block. This fixes a product decode path independently of native dropout; the named computation and RNG/dropout oracle remain independent.

Routes forward keys through existing ArrayStacked.fold with explicit key in_axes, preserving the one-layer unsplit edge and nested block/attention/QKV/MLP/projection splits. Projection-boundary geometry preserves named dense o-projection head-major masks. Direct logits split the root once; activations/next-token loss use their supplied root directly. No new Haliax import, trainer, stack implementation or base attention dropout is introduced.

Preserves named input axis order and logical mask order at the LM boundary; unbatched replicated examples share one logical mask. The explicit reshard before selecting row zero restores a valid gradient transpose layout. Direct-logit versus loss key schedules and paged layer/projection keys match the existing named API; paged output uses position-major masks. Changes use existing loss/checkpoint/generation infrastructure.

Keeps independent Bernoulli/NumPy value and input/factor/base-gradient oracles at p=0/0.25/1, with nonzero A/B and row/column placement checks. Adds independent named model loss/factor-gradient/logit comparisons for one/two layers and batch-first/reversed/unbatched axes, changed-key sensitivity, inference and missing-key behavior. Paged prefill and continuation check logits and KV caches against the named implementation. Factor copying transfers serialized values only; named code does not reuse ArrayDropout or DropoutLayout. Existing tolerances are preserved; hardware tests retain literal tpu and bounded timeout markers.

Extends the existing real train_lm local-HF fixture with nonzero dropout and random A/B. Uninterrupted three-step training must equal two-step plus restored third step in all saved arrays, including optimizer/RNG state; frozen-base, Adam moments, adapter/merged exports and reloaded inference remain checked. Inference mode is explicitly set for comparisons to merged weights. Uses existing local source/tokenizer fixtures, literal tpu marker and 180-second timeout; no parallel trainer or historical trial fixture is added.

supported_scope: Native LoRA decoder projections q/k/v/o/gate/up/down with explicit training PRNG keys; p=0 bypass, p=1 all-drop with active-mode key requirement, and keyless inference mode.
Existing raw/native LM forward, canonical activations/loss and direct logits with their respective named root-key schedules; layer and nested projection splitting including the single-layer edge.

At most one public named batch axis, batch-first or position-first order, and unbatched API calls with replicated logical-example masks; logical o-projection order differs between dense and paged attention.

Existing paged causal prefill/continuation and inference-mode generation, factor sharding, checkpoint continuation, PEFT export and merged local export within their existing configuration restrictions.
unsupported_or_unproven_scope: Accelerator correctness, communication cost, throughput, performance or convergence are not established by this source review or the reported CPU results.

Reported named/native numerical execution covers small float32 dense Llama shapes with vanilla named/reference native attention, one/two layers, and CPU1/4. Other backends and reduced precision nonzero-dropout numerics were not executed in the supplied report.

The reported real canonical continuation/export execution covers untied HF source with p=0.25 on CPU1/4. The tied source parameter exists in the maintained fixture but is not reported executed for this patch; broader safe-test and CI acceptance are separate.

Multiple public named batch axes, native output-head adaptation, native LoRA-DPO composition, and base attention/residual dropout are outside this contribution; existing architecture/HF/export restrictions still apply.
